OFFICE OF THE ASSISTANT COMMISSIONER OF POLICE
CRIME BRANCH, NEW DELHI

INVESTIGATION REPORT - CASE-A-001
FIR No: 0142/2026, Police Station: Connaught Place
Investigating Officer: SI Manpreet Singh

1. Case Background:
On 12/03/2026, a case was registered upon the complaint of Rajesh Kumar Sharma,
S/o Ramesh Sharma, residing at Flat 102, Shanti Vihar, Rohini Sector 9, New Delhi 110085.
The primary suspect was identified as Vikram Singh alias Vicky.

2. Initial Investigation:
The investigating team inspected the spot at Connaught Place.
Complainant Rajesh Kumar Sharma was examined under Section 161 Cr.P.C.
The suspect used mobile phone +919876543210 to orchestrate transactions.

pages.2:
INVESTIGATION REPORT - CASE-A-001 (Page 2)

3. Surveillance and Variant Name Analysis:
During interrogation of associates, the suspect was referred to as Vikrum Singh.
Surveillance confirmed Vikrum Singh operates vehicle DL01AB1234 in the National Capital Region.
The vehicle DL01AB1234 was sighted near Connaught Place on 10/03/2026.

4. Interrogation of Local Informants:
Informants corroborated that Vikrum Singh and Vikram Singh are the same individual.
Vehicle DL01AB1234 was seized as material evidence.
SYNTHETIC TEST DATA - REPORTLAB INVARIANT - PAGE 2

INVESTIGATION REPORT - CASE-A-001 (Page 3)

5. Technical and CDR Evidence:
CDR analysis for phone +919876543210 reveals active communication during the incident.
Handset IMEI 860123045678900 was associated with the active subscriber card.
Bank transactions regarding account 001234567890 substantiate fund movement.

6. Conclusion & Recommendations:
Notice under Section 41A Cr.P.C. served upon Vikram Singh.
Vehicle DL01AB1234 deposited at PS Malkhana.
Submitted by SI Manpreet Singh.
